about: Real street skeletons of the large towns whose old plan is open, for settlement feature 3 (docs/SETTLEMENT_DESIGN.md). Per site of the gazetteer: the market (x, z) and the streets as pieces [x0, z0, x1, z1] east-west or north-south, east and south of the centre of the town, in radii of the real town (radius: the real metres of one; the world lays a plan as wide as its own town). Written by tools/settlement/cadastre_skeleton.py (Paris) and cadastre_venice.py (Venice).

68.source: Vasserot cadastre 1810-1836 (ALPAGE via Stanford EarthWorks, ODbL 1.0) inside the wall of Philippe Auguste (ALPAGE walls, Noizet & Lallau 2013); centre: the parvis of Notre-Dame

1329.source: Venice 1808 Land Registers v1.1 (EPFL DHLAB, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20715172, CC BY 4.0): the streets and sottoportici of the Napoleonic land register; centre: the Basilica di San Marco; market: Campo San Giacomo di Rialto
